column1: GOAL · In 6 months, fill Saturday 6/6 monthly seats, launch Wednesday 19:00–22:00 with at least 4/6 paid seats, and raise second-month renewal from about 50% to 65%. Assume Wednesday uses the same six wheels and capacity.
column2: CUSTOMER · Prioritize local women 28–45 in Chacarita, Colegiales, Villa Crespo and Palermo seeking a calm, hands-on break; welcome English-speaking residents. Treat tourists as mug buyers, not the core class audience.
column3: OFFER · Lead with the four-Saturday wheel course: ARS 120,000, clay and firing included. Use the ARS 40,000 'Probá el torno' taster as an entry point and invite attendees to the next monthly group; show the location and WhatsApp booking link everywhere.

column1: FAIR TO CHAT · Put a class sign and QR code beside the mugs: '¿Querés probar el torno? Escribime por WhatsApp'. Invite locals who ask about classes to scan it before leaving; ask whether Saturday or Wednesday suits them. Keep selling mugs without using kiln capacity for wholesale.
column2: INSTAGRAM + MAPS · Post two short wheel videos weekly, with a Spanish caption, a one-line English summary, price, neighborhood and a WhatsApp call to action. Pin a class post with dates and seats; replace the PDF-first bio path with a direct WhatsApp link. Create a Google Business Profile for local class searches.
column3: BOOK + FOLLOW UP · Reply to class chats within 24 hours with dates, price, address, what is included and payment steps. Log name, source, preferred day and status in a simple sheet. Follow up once after 48 hours; message taster attendees the next day with a specific opening in the monthly group.

column1: KEEP + REFER · In week 3 of each course, ask each student about next month and offer the available Saturday or Wednesday place. Invite happy students to bring a friend to a taster; ask permission before sharing photos or testimonials. Open Wednesday once four students have paid, then aim for six.
column2: WEEKLY ROUTINE · Cap marketing at 5 hours: 2 hours film/post, 1.5 hours WhatsApp replies and follow-ups, 1 hour renewal/referral and neighborhood outreach, 0.5 hour update the sheet. Use fair conversations during existing fair time.
column3: MONEY + SCORECARD · Spend at most ARS 70,000/month excluding the fair stall: up to ARS 15,000 once for QR/sign printing, then test up to ARS 50,000/month of local Instagram ads only if organic inquiries are too few. Each week track class inquiries by source, tasters, paid seats by group and next-month renewals; review progress monthly.
